English: Pilgrims Path
A humble, marked trail with waystones and simple shrines, providing safety and spiritual guidance to the first pilgrims.
Wooden Shelter
Simple wooden huts erected along the path, offering rudimentary protection for weary pilgrims.
Pilgrims Hostel
A communal timber structure where pilgrims can rest, pray, and share stories in modest comfort.
Pilgrims Infirmary
A stone wing with beds and attendants for tending to the needs of ailing travelers, staffed by learned clergy.
Stone Rest House
A sturdy masonry building, providing shelter and a small chapel for prayer, indicating the paths growing importance.
Wayfarers Lodge
A multi-story guesthouse with private chambers and a refectory, welcoming pilgrims and dignitaries alike.
Pilgrimage Courtyard
A walled courtyard with gardens and covered arcades, offering a tranquil space for prayer and gatherings.
Pilgrimage Inn
A grand inn with expanded facilities, hosting gatherings of pilgrims, clergy, and scholars, and serving as a center for religious discourse.
Pilgrims Hospice
A fortified complex for the care and accommodation of large numbers of pilgrims, with dedicated chapels and scriptorium.
Grand Pilgrims Hall
A monumental hall adorned with sacred art, housing relics, and serving as a beacon for the faithful across realms.
